redaction: absolute paths, raw filenames, personal identifiers and raw waveforms omitted; anonymous session namespace retained
scope: formal mmWave batch QC and ECG/RSP criterion-attribution only; no focus modeling; no algorithm change

rules.ecg: 0.5-40 Hz bandpass; R-peak distance >=0.3 s; IBI 300-2000 ms; adjacent IBI relative change >20% rejected; usable if normal RR ratio >=80%
rules.rsp: 0.1-0.7 Hz bandpass; peak distance >=0.5 s; 6-42 breaths/min; low-amplitude loose-belt flag; usable if normal cycle ratio >=80%; median rate
rules.mmwave: existing v3.1.1/time-gated outputs; 10 s heart-band signal-presence windows; independent block analysis; no cross-block IBI/HRV concatenation
rules.formal_v1_session_gate: window_quality_pct >=80 and probe_quality_pct >=80, plus no existing target-lock geometry/phase instability flag; this is a QC eligibility rule, not a claim of physiological accuracy
rules.ecg_label_tuning: no ECG/RSP labels used to tune formal-batch v1 parameters; ECG/RSP used only as independent reference/attribution evidence

reference_cohort.source: existing strict BIOPAC ECG/RSP comparison artifact
